tools.name: colab_dashboard
tools.title: Open Colab Pilot dashboard
tools.description: Open the interactive Colab Pilot dashboard showing Compute Unit balance, burn rate, monthly budget guardrail, active sessions with live GPU, VRAM, system RAM, disk, and CPU telemetry, detached jobs, and alarm controls.

tools.name: colab_allocate_cascade
tools.title: Allocate GPU cascade
tools.description: Try GPU tiers in priority order (supporting prefer_gpus, high_mem, and configurable per-tier timeouts), verify BF16 support, probe VRAM, system RAM, and NVENC availability, and return safe DataLoader and crop sizing.

tools.name: colab_mount_rclone
tools.title: Mount Google Drive with rclone
tools.description: Configure rclone and mount Google Drive headlessly on a Colab VM with workload-tuned VFS flags and optional secret forwarding.

tools.name: colab_smart_transfer
tools.title: Transfer files safely
tools.description: Transfer single or batch files between workstation, Google Drive, and Colab VMs with auto-mkdir direct upload, async Drive staging, remote_glob downloads, and headless drive_pull archive extraction.

tools.name: colab_launch_detached
tools.title: Launch detached job
tools.description: Launch a local or already-staged remote Python script detached with nohup, cwd and custom log mirroring, warm-chain process cleanup, carriage-return log normalization, and 10-second GPU heartbeat status.

tools.name: colab_poll_job
tools.title: Poll detached job
tools.description: Poll a detached Colab job, background Drive transfer, or ad-hoc process, log path, and artifacts directory with live GPU, VRAM, RAM, and disk telemetry.

tools.name: colab_exec
tools.title: Run bounded remote command
tools.description: Run a bounded one-shot shell command or Python snippet on a Colab VM (auto-routing over SSH when the kernel is busy) with optional safe PID cleanup and file glob removal.

tools.name: colab_reset_vram
tools.title: Reset zombie VRAM
tools.description: Clear sys.last_traceback, IPython Out caches, optional globals, and torch.cuda.empty_cache to reclaim VRAM after a failed cell.

tools.name: colab_keep_warm
tools.title: Register keep-warm lease
tools.description: Register or clear a timed keep-warm lease for a Colab session so the Stop guardrail allows ending a turn intentionally.

tools.name: colab_stop_all
tools.title: Stop Colab sessions
tools.description: Stop one named Colab session or all active sessions, clear leases, and return verified Compute Unit usage.

tools.name: colab_wakeup_alarm
tools.title: Control wakeup alarm
tools.description: Start, stop, inspect, or test the escalating macOS text-to-speech and chirp wakeup alarm.
